# N3XT 3D - AI Agent Documentation

## Overview
This is the official `llms.txt` file for N3XT 3D, providing structured information for AI agents interacting with our web platform. N3XT 3D is a premium 3D manufacturing studio specializing in industrial precision and high-quality collectibles.

## Structure
- The platform uses Vue 3 and TailwindCSS
- We provide services such as 3D printing (FDM, SLA), airbrushing, and project quoting.
- All technical documentation and public pages are structured with accessibility in mind.

## Navigation
To navigate our ecosystem, agents can safely index:
- `/` - Home
- `/catalog` - Curated Catalog
- `/gallery` - Past Projects
- `/project/init` - Quotation Request

For any automated indexing or assistance, respect our API rate limits and structural semantics.
